transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I guess I'm just... having trouble getting things done. Like, I'll try to sit down and work on a job application, but... I don't know. I just get pulled off track by every little thing. 

A car driving by outside, my phone, or just some random thought. I usually end up doing something completely different before I even notice I stopped working.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?
Yeah, I guess. Um... if I'm sitting with someone, my leg is usually bouncing. Or I'll just be clicking a pen or... messing with my keys. I don't really realize I'm doing it most of the time.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Um... I don't know. Not really, I guess. I don't think I do.
Do you have trouble focusing or getting distracted in different situations, like at work, at home, or in social settings?

Um... I guess so. Yeah, it happens at home a lot. And... when I'm out with friends sometimes, I guess. I don't really know about work right now, since I don't have a job. But yeah, it's just... around.
Do you think your trouble with focusing and getting distracted is causing problems for you in your daily life?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... I've been trying to get into this automotive technician thing. But I just... I don't know, I keep missing the training deadlines. And I've had to redo my applications a bunch of times because of it. So I'm just... not really moving forward with it at all right now. Even though I know I can handle the hands-on work fine. It's just... yeah.
Did you have trouble sitting still or fidgeting when you were a kid?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean, even back in elementary school, my teachers were always... moving my desk around. Because I'd talk out of turn, or I'd forget my homework. And... I guess I'd just rush through the worksheets and make a bunch of careless mistakes. So... yeah, it was kind of like that back then, too.
Were you often described as 'on the go' or having an abundance of energy when you were a child?

Um... I don't really know. I don't remember people saying that exactly. I mean, I moved around a lot, like I said, but... I don't know if they called it having a lot of energy. Just... couldn't sit still, I guess.
Did you have trouble paying attention or following instructions when you were a kid?

Um... yeah. Kind of like I was saying a minute ago... about them always moving my seat. I just... I guess I didn't really listen when they gave out the homework, so I'd forget it. And... I didn't really follow the instructions on those worksheets either. I'd just rush through them and make mistakes. So... yeah.
Did you have any of these problems with focusing, fidgeting, or getting distracted when you were a teenager?
Um... I don't really remember high school that well. I guess it was probably just... more of the same. I didn't really pay attention to it, to be honest.
Have you experienced these problems with focusing and getting distracted at school, at work, and at home?
Um... I guess so. Yeah. It's just kind of... everywhere, I suppose. I don't really keep track of where it happens most. It's just... how it is.
Did you have any of these problems with focusing, fidgeting, or getting distracted before you started elementary school?
Um... I really don't know. That was a long time ago. I don't remember anything before school.
Were you often running, climbing, or playing physical games when you were a kid?
Um... not really, no. I mean, I guess I played outside sometimes, but... I don't remember doing all that too much. Just... normal kid stuff, I think.
Have you ever interrupted others during conversations?
Um... yeah, I guess. I kind of... cut people off sometimes. Like my mom, or... the counselor. It's just... an answer pops into my head, and I... I just say it before they're done talking.
Have your problems with focusing, fidgeting, or getting distracted caused you significant distress or problems in your relationships or daily activities?

Um... yeah, I guess. It kind of... messes things up. Like... I've been trying to become an automotive technician. I know I can handle the hands-on work fine, but... I don't know, I keep missing the training deadlines. And I've had to redo my applications a bunch of times because of it. So... I'm just not really moving forward right now.
Were you often described as hyperactive or having too much energy when you were a child?

Um... I guess so. Yeah. Even back in elementary school... my teachers were always, you know, moving my seat. Said I talked out of turn too much. And... I guess I'd forget my homework a lot, or just... rush through the worksheets and make dumb mistakes. So... yeah, maybe.
Do you often feel restless or have an inability to engage in activities quietly as an adult?

Um... yeah, I guess. Quiet stuff is... it's hard for me. Like, if my family is trying to watch a movie, or... if I try to sit down and read something. I just... I start talking, or getting up. I make noise. I don't... I don't mean to bother anyone, it just happens.
Have you experienced problems with focusing, fidgeting, or getting distracted in most areas of your life for as long as you can remember?

Um... no, not really. I mean... it hasn't always been like this. It really just started getting bad about... maybe a year and 10 months ago? I used to play soccer a lot, and... I got hurt. It messed up my whole routine. So... yeah, it's just been since then, really.

Have you experienced problems with focusing, fidgeting, or getting distracted consistently across different settings, such as at home, in social situations, and in work or school settings, for most of your life?
Um... no, not really. I mean... like I just said, it hasn't been my whole life. It's mostly just... since the injury. Before that, I was fine. It's just... lately.
Do you often blurting out answers before questions have been completed?
Um... yeah. I guess I do that. I cut people off a lot. Like... my mom, or the counselor. It's just... an answer pops into my head, and I just say it. Before they're done talking.
Have you experienced these problems with focusing, fidgeting, or getting distracted for at least 6 months?
Yeah. Like I said... it's been about a year and 10 months. Since the soccer thing. That's when it all got messed up.
